lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: Cohort 01, you were selected because this mission requires people who can adapt for decades, not simply survive a launch. Asteria is not a rescue. It is a beginning. If you board, you are agreeing to help decide what that beginning becomes.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: Take the time you need. We are listening.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: Because humanity should never have only one home. Earth is not dying. We are choosing to build a second civilization on Asteria-4.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: You do not have to know who you will become before you board. Fear can travel with you. It does not have to make the decision.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: To adapt for decades, work across departments, and help decide what this beginning becomes. The mission needs people who can change.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: Then take this moment. What would staying cost your character? What might leaving make possible? The choice should mean something.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: Welcome aboard Pioneer. The ship has six decks. Each department should choose one place it thinks will matter most—and tell us why.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: We will disagree. When we do, speak plainly, listen closely, and make your reasons visible to one another.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: Start with the people who depend on your work. Explain your choice. Another department may see a need you have missed.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: You do not have to know who you will become before you board. We will need more than one kind of courage.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: If you forgot to say goodbye to someone, you have about forty seconds to decide whether that matters. Take a breath. Who are you leaving behind?

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Take the time you need. We are listening.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Then give your character something to do with their hands. We can see a tightened strap or a folded note. We cannot see a thought.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Then look. Let the others decide whether to wait or keep walking. That picture can tell us something before anybody speaks.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Show us. Who crosses first? Who hangs back? Who notices? You can disagree and still cross the same line.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Why you are leaving, what you want, what you might need to learn, what you fear losing, and one object from Earth. Use your fictional character's name.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: This is your ship too. Find somewhere you can imagine belonging. A bunk, a table, a view. What would make a room feel like yours?

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Something small enough to carry and large enough to remind me. What is your object? Tell us what it holds that the ship cannot replace.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: A fresh start still has you in it. What do you want here—and what might you need to learn before you can have it?

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Begin with one detail. A shared routine, a plant, a place to sit. Tell your company what you would change and why.

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: Cohort 01 biometric integration complete. Department credentials recognized. How may I assist?

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: Take the time you need. We are listening.

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: CSV-01 Pioneer. Destination: Asteria-4. Mission: establish a deliberate second civilization. Earth remains habitable.

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: Flight navigates. Science investigates. Engineering maintains the ship. Colony helps a community take shape. Each department depends on the others.

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: A badge connects a crew identity to a department. The person behind that identity still chooses what to say and do.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: Speak plainly. Tell the crew what you see before you tell them what it means.

lines.speaker: okafor
lines.text: Your body is part of the mission equipment. Unlike the equipment, you are allowed to disagree with me.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: This is your ship too. What would make a room feel like yours?

lines.speaker: rhee
lines.text: Every ship is a collection of problems that have agreed not to happen at the same time.

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: insufficient image duration for classification.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: Welcome aboard Pioneer.

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: Route correction accepted.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: Who entered that correction?

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: No correction was entered.
